messages:
Sam L: Observed a sudden spike in egress-cost-shedding triggers in us-east1 around 11:02 UTC — customers seeing 503s on large embedding writes. Opening channel.

Alex (oncall): Looking. Alert shows ingress-proxy started rejecting/queuing writes when egress budget exceeded. I’m rolling back the new burst-window config.

infra-deploy-bot: Rollback deployment rdb-ec-window v2 -> v1 initiated by Alex. CI job #4456 started.

Ben S (SRE): Confirmed: embed-store write fanout + new rate-window math causes overaggressive shedding for >1MB requests.

Maya R (Support): Seeing ~14 impacted orgs, 3 high-priority. Raising to CS leads and drafting customer-facing note.

Priya K (EngInfra): I’ve disabled the egress-shedding rule temporarily and bumped the circuit back to permissive. Monitoring for stabilization.

Sam L: Status page updated: https://status.redwood.com/incident/2823456789 — note says degraded writes in us-east1, mitigation in progress. :loudspeaker:

Alex (oncall): Error rate dropped ~85% after rollback. Some queues draining; expect normal by +8m.

Maya R (Support): Sending short customer update to affected accounts now. Template: "We're aware of intermittent 503s for large embedding uploads in us-east1; mitigation in progress; we'll follow up."

Ben S (SRE): Root-cause hypothesis: edge ingress change to rate window math + sudden fanout from embedding dedupe job. Will instrument metrics for fanout per-request size.

Sam L: Postmortem owner: Ben S. Action items: 1) Revert ingress change in canary until tests for >1MB flows (Priya), 2) Add canary for embedding-write fanout detection (Ben), 3) Customer comms follow-up (Maya), 4) Update runbook thresholds (Alex).

Product Team: Flagging an impact review for Dedicated and Private customers; PM to coordinate outreach.

comms-bot: Draft customer message reviewed by Maya, queued for send at 11:25 UTC.

Alex (oncall): Closing alert for now, keeping channel open for 2h observation window. If anyone sees reappearance, ping @oncall immediately. :thumbsup:

Maya R (Support): Noted — will escalate if any of the 3 HP accounts report continued issues.

Sam L: Final: services stabilizing, ETA for postmortem and timeline doc by EOD. Thanks everyone for quick response. :heart:
